about_the_game:
DayRise is an enhanced version of the first Welcome To... Chichester 2 visual novel, bringing the first episode to be more in line with the rest of the series and expanding the narrarative into areas that the original Welcome To... Chichester 2 - Part I story never did.

Grendel Jinx, the megalomaniacal kleptomaniac, has returned to Chichester, England, for a secret mission.  This time, she has dragged (quite literally) the protagonist along with her.  Whilst Grendel is focused on her tasks, the protagonist is still suffering from having been forced to destroy The Council.

Meanwhile, Cindi Eglantine's job as a tourist guide is progressing well.  Unfortunately, she has now attracted the attention of a stalker, known as Leighton Pool.

Grendel has paid Cindi to keep the protagonist well away from the city for the complete week, which the protagonist instantly realises is suspicious.

Will the protagonist be able to figure out what Grendel is up to, and if necessary, stop her?

  • Play as a male or female protagonist

  • Choices lead to new story routes

  • Unique story for this episode, which brings this story up to date with the series

  • New additional character

  • CGs are now included in the story

  • Internal and Steam achievements
